purpose: Prioritize a small first tranche of remaining post-Qin CORE rulers for research/distillation after the Qin-to-Qing P0 backbone is complete.
non_goal: This is not a ranking of historical worth, legitimacy, morality, ethnicity, fame, or political importance.

dimensions.meaning: How readily a defensible source/research base can be established without padding or speculative psychology.
How much this person opens an uncovered polity, parallel regime, regional sequence, or comparison lane in the current corpus.
Value for controlled comparisons against already-distilled rulers or other P1 candidates.
Value for understanding regime formation, collapse, succession rupture, conquest, restoration, or institutional transition.
Expected usefulness for later simulation, network comparison, counterfactual analysis, and data visualization once the evidence base is sound.

ranking.method: weighted scheduling score after all five dimensions are manually/agent reviewed
ranking.warning: The score is only a work-scheduling heuristic. It must never be reused as historical quality, ruler quality, or Nuwa semantic quality.

screening_queue.purpose: Order unreviewed candidates for scoring without pretending they already have anchor scores.
machine_signals: number of currently missing P1 candidates sharing each polity
number of polity memberships for the person
screening_queue.rule: Machine signals may order the review queue but cannot fill any of the five reviewed dimensions.

guardrails: Do not fill a tranche only from one dynasty/polity because its sources are easier.
Do not promote REVIEW/EXTENDED/LEGENDARY entries into P1.
LIMITED-EVIDENCE is allowed if the model claims are correspondingly constrained.
Every scored dimension requires a short rationale; no unexplained numbers.
A candidate with incomplete scoring remains NEEDS_REVIEW and receives no final rank.
